svg.title: DFD Level 1 — logical data flow
svg.desc: The context process opened into seven verb-and-noun processes with seven logical data stores. Same external entities and boundary flows as Level 0; technology names are deliberately absent.
svg.text: Process 0 opened into seven processes. Data stores D1–D7 hold state; process names say what happens to the data, not which software does it.

g.text: phrase to intent, text to labels
verify, save, opt in, send digest

svg.text: search, filters, view ⇄ calendar, ICS, picks
Every Level 0 flow appears here, split across the process that handles it, and no external entity was added. Store D2 only holds drafts: 6.0 decides
what becomes public. Dashed processes and stores are planned. A double-headed arrow is one conversation (request and response), not two flows.
